resources.string: Reverse uses the converted value as the new input and swaps units. Floating-point conversions may not round-trip exactly.

Undo/Redo affects editor values and units only, not copying, sharing or saved history. This undo stack keeps up to 20 edits within a 64 KiB budget in memory and is cleared on restore/import or leaving this session.
Up to 100 lines and 4,096 characters. Blank or invalid lines receive an error; they are never skipped. All rows use the current category and unit pair.
Input not accepted: maximum 4,096 characters. Nothing was truncated.
Input not accepted: maximum 100 lines. Nothing was truncated.

Batch results are recorded only after Convert batch when your history/result settings allow it. Restore loads batch inputs and units, then requires Convert batch again. Batch comparison is not supported. Undo/Redo does not restore generated batch output.
This full batch exceeds the saved-entry size limit and will not be saved to history, remembered results or Workbench. Nothing is truncated. Copy or Share the full result instead.
